race.comment: BANGKOK HOTTIE (1) was a run ahead of her main rivals when she stalked the speed and surged clear to score a comfortable win in the G2 Furious Stakes at this track. Should be even stronger over this trip and can repeat the effort. CHILLY GIRL (2) was well ridden along the inside and given every chance late when second in the G2 Furious Stakes. Expect to see her take control early and try and pinch it in the straight. Slight niggle is the trip. STRIKING ALIBI (3) carved out sharp closing splits first up with a slashing third in the G2 Furious Stakes. Is a run or two behind most of these but look to see J Mac weave his magic. GLOBAL GOAL (6) kept fresh after motoring late first up when third in the G2 Silver Shadow Stakes over 1200m here. Since fitted with a 1050m trial win at Randwick. Winkers go on and can't be dismissed. QUEEN'S GAMBLE (7) is fifth up heading into this with different formlines. Proven at the trip and worth thought.
